_note: SYNTHETIC smoke scenario for one live run of core/team (scripts/team_smoke.py). The service, log, runbook and incident are made up. Roles, models and skills come from config/skills.json and prices from config/prices.json; the operator catalog below is data for this scenario only (no catalog exists in config/ yet). The planted root cause is what the run should find; it is checked deterministically against the claims the operators cite.
goal: Explain what went wrong with the parcelpost-api service between 02:12 and 02:22 UTC, citing the evidence by source and line.

root_cause.summary: Config bundle config_version=42 (change CHG-0917) cut db.pool.max_connections from 50 to 5. The pool saturated (active=5, max=5, growing queue) and requests failed with PoolTimeout and HTTP 503, while the database itself stayed healthy. Rolling back to config_version=41 restored the pool and cleared the errors. The Redis flush, cache miss warnings, GC pauses and the disk warning are red herrings.
